questions.text: Is the dizziness in the mornings the tablets or is it my heart?
Can I fly to Accra in December for my grandson's wedding?
Do I still need the blood test every month?
Is it alright to keep taking the ibuprofen for my knee?
What should I do if my pulse goes under fifty again?

facts.text: Ada has been taking ibuprofen most days for her knee since the beginning of the month.
facts.source_quote: I've been taking the ibuprofen most days, it's the only thing that touches the knee

facts.text: The pharmacy on Oxford Street closes at five on Fridays.
facts.source_quote: remember the Oxford Street one shuts at five on a Friday, not six

facts.text: The clinic asked Ada to bring the heart monitor readings to the September appointment.
facts.source_quote: they want the monitor printouts brought in with you on the Tuesday

facts.text: Ada's grandson's wedding is in Accra on the twelfth of December.
facts.source_quote: the twelfth, so we'd want to fly out on the ninth or the tenth

facts.text: Ada's amlodipine box was collected on the fifteenth and is roughly three quarters full.
facts.source_quote: picked the amlodipine up today, there's still most of the last one left
